narrator.instruct: Gripping, energetic storyteller telling a true, surprising history story with wonder, brisk, excited and punchy, never calm.

farmer.instruct: A hungry German farmer in 1816 shaking an empty oat sack over a thin horse, exasperated and half laughing at his bad luck, quick and loud.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A volcano on the other side of the world may have put a German on the first bicycle.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: April, eighteen fifteen. Mount Tambora in Indonesia exploded, the most powerful eruption in recorded history.
lines.say: April, eighteen fifteen. Mount Tam-bora in Indonesia exploded, the most powerful eruption in recorded history.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Its sulphur veiled the sky, and the whole planet cooled.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In Europe, eighteen sixteen became the year without a summer. Cold rain rotted the harvests.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But oats grew scarce and costly, and many could no longer feed their horses.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Many horses starved, or were slaughtered for meat and hides. Without a horse, every trip to town meant walking.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In Mannheim, an inventor named Karl Drais dreamed up a horse that never eats.
lines.say: In Mann-hime, an inventor named Karl Dry-ss dreamed up a horse that never eats.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So he built one out of wood. But where did the legs go?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You see, his running machine had two wooden wheels in a line, a seat, and a handlebar to steer.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: There were no pedals at all. You pushed off the ground with your feet, then glided.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: On June twelfth, eighteen seventeen, he rode it to a coaching inn and back in about an hour.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One historian argues the starving horses inspired him, though nobody can prove it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Pedals came decades later. Every bike you ride began as a wooden horse that never needed oats.
